answer: Sybil resistance here means charging every identity real compute before it can attest. Each agent must solve proof-of-work, so a clone costs exactly what an honest node costs. A falcon diving still fights the same air; a forged swarm cannot skip that toll. The kernel is linear cost for the attacker with nearly flat benefit per extra pseudo-agent, so a thousand clones buy barely more weight than one. Honest agents on the cold tundra amortize spend while each new face starts at zero. Ten thousand clones at a few cents of GPU time each burns hundreds of dollars for influence real peers offset.
